name: Surigao, Spanish Third District
locator: Vol. III, printed p. 111, Number of Inhabitants, 1898 official guide
definition: Population attributed to the Spanish Third District in the 1898 official guide. The 1902 War Department gazetteer says the count excluded Indigenous groups not covered by the regular returns. The date and method of the underlying count are unreported.
method: printed historical count reproduced in a contemporary official report
